raw: The rotation improved the error to 169mm, which is closer to the 25mm tolerance, but still not sufficient. The door still appears misaligned and interpenetrating the body. Since translation along Y and rotation around Z didn’t fully resolve the issue, I will now try scaling the door along the Y-axis to adjust its size and ensure it seats flush against the body without interpenetration. A slight scaling down may help correct the fit.

The scaling made the situation worse, increasing the error to 246mm. This suggests the door is too large or misaligned in a way that scaling exacerbates the issue. I will now try a smaller downward translation to adjust the door’s position and reduce interpenetration. A smaller Y translation may help align the door properly without overcorrecting.

The small downward translation reduced the error slightly but still falls short of the 25mm tolerance. The door remains interpenetrating the body, suggesting the issue may involve both position and orientation. I will now try rotating the door around the Y-axis to realign it properly, as this might help seat it flush without interpenetration. A small rotation should help without overcorrecting.

The Y-axis rotation slightly increased the error to 217mm, indicating that rotation around Y is not helping. Since translation and rotation attempts have not resolved the issue, I will now try scaling the door along the X-axis to adjust its width and ensure it fits flush against the body without interpenetration. A slight scaling may help correct the fit.

The X-axis scaling did not improve the error and left it at 215mm. Since scaling and rotations have failed, and translation has not fully resolved the interpenetration, I will now try a larger downward translation along the Y-axis to push the door into proper seating. This may be the most direct way to resolve the misalignment.

The large downward translation worsened the error to 243mm, indicating that pushing the door further down is making the problem worse. Since all previous attempts have failed, I will now try a small upward translation to lift the door slightly and reduce interpenetration. This may help realign the door without overcorrecting.
